# Phase 2 results (auto-generated by `python -m scout.ml.train`)

Scope: snapshots from 2013-07-01 whose club was in a core league at the snapshot date. In scope: 163,902. Train (snapshot and target both before 2023-07-01): 125,204. Val (2023-07-01 to 2024-07-01): 12,086. Test (from 2024-07-01): 12,393.
LightGBM early-stopped at 199 trees.

Direction acc. = share of snapshots whose value changed where sign(prediction) == sign(actual); n/a for no-change, which never predicts a direction.
